edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the dispute concerning [identify the underlying transaction, events, relevant dates, and any action caption and case number] (the “Dispute”). edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT SUBJECT TO CLIENT APPROVAL] (the “Settlement Amount”) within 10 business days after the Effective Date, by wire transfer pursuant to separately verified payment instructions. “Business day” means a day other than Saturday, Sunday, or a federal banking holiday in the United States.
edits.name: Payment timing

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, and liabilities, whether known or unknown, arising out of the Dispute and based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the Effective Date, to the extent such claims may lawfully be released. This release does not extend to unrelated matters, claims based on acts or omissions after the Effective Date, or any rights or obligations under this Agreement, including the right to enforce it.
edits.name: Release scope and enforcement reservation

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers, insurers, and auditors who need to know such terms and are subject to professional confidentiality duties or agree to maintain confidentiality; disclosures required by law; or disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party making a legally required disclosure shall give the other party reasonable advance notice and disclose only what is required. Nothing in this section limits either party’s right to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Permitted confidential disclosures
